newsitem.title: UK: Speaker Boothroyd raps UK govt over media leaks.
newsitem.headline: Speaker Boothroyd raps UK govt over media leaks.

text.p: House of Commons Speaker Betty Boothroyd issued a sharp rebuke on Monday to the government over media leaks at the weekend of a report due on Wednesday into the funding of higher education in Britain.
Boothroyd said the practice of advance briefings had grown over the past 20 years to the point at which the rights of parliament were being overlooked.
"The House is rightly jealous of its role in holding ministers to account.

"If it is to fulfil its function properly, it must be the first to learn of important developments in government policy, and I deprecate most strongly any action that is taken that tends to undermine this important principle," she said in reponse to a complaint by the opposition Conservative party.
